description: This file provides internationalization (i18n) translations for the Select2 plugin in Afrikaans. It defines localized messages for error handling, input validation, loading indicators, and other UI interactions specific to the Afrikaans language.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results fail to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Provides a message indicating the number of characters to remove when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Provides a message prompting the user to enter more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Displays a message when additional results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Indicates the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message shown when no search results are found.
